Essay is early. It writes plain Markdown and never takes your file
hostage, but expect rough edges and please say when you hit one.

Download the installer for your platform below. Existing
installations update themselves within the hour.

**macOS:** these builds are unsigned, so the first launch needs
right-click on the app, then Open — double-clicking will refuse.
Every launch after that is normal, and updates are unaffected.

**Linux:** `.deb` for Debian and Ubuntu, `.AppImage` for anything
else. Only the AppImage updates itself.
